retrievalProfile.description: A multi-person group portrait set against a vibrant airbrushed gradient background with aggressive brush-stroke typography and neon accents.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered group of performers in 1980s formal-casual attire standing on a stage-like floor with radiating light beams, framed by a deep purple and cyan airbrushed sky featuring stylized shooting stars and a large, jagged brush-script title.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject group centered against a high-contrast color gradient
Aggressive, hand-painted title overlapping the top of the frame
Radiating floor perspective lines converging toward the center
Vibrant purple borders contrasting with a central warm-to-cool vertical gradient
coreInvariants: Neon cyan and magenta accent streaks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body group centered horizontally, occupying the middle 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, salmon-colored brush-script title at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top title, moves down through the central figure, and fans out to the group members before following the floor lines back to the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense central subject area with expansive airbrushed sky at the top and sides.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and violet framing the outer edges.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan and pale yellow creating a central 'glow' behind the subjects.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Salmon pink for the primary title and neon cyan for secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with high-value highlights on the floor and central sky.

letterConstructionRules: Dry-brush texture with visible bristle streaks
Thick, gestural strokes with sharp terminals
Underlining created by a horizontal brush swipe
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders are elongated into sharp points
Letters are tightly packed and overlapping
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, textured script paired with a clean, widely-spaced geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, dry-brush texture of the main title.
Appropriate geometric skeleton for the secondary text when tracked out.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an 80s airbrushed background with a central yellow-to-cyan vertical gradient framed by deep purple. Add a group of 7 people in 80s formal-casual attire (blazers, high-waisted trousers, ruffles) standing on a floor with radiating light beams. Add neon cyan and magenta streaks in the upper corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, salmon-colored brush-script title at the top center with a dry-brush texture. Add a secondary title at the bottom in a wide-tracked cyan geometric sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the main title textured like a dry brush?
Does the background have a smooth airbrushed gradient?
Is the secondary text widely spaced?
Are the floor lines converging toward the center?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
Width of the floor perspective lines
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original group

mustAchieve: Hand-painted feel for the main title

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the title does not look like a standard computer font.
Check that the purple borders are sufficiently saturated.
Verify the floor lines create a sense of depth.
Confirm the 80s fashion silhouettes are maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Pop Aesthetic = (Airbrushed Gradient + Brush Script Title) / (Group Portrait + Neon Accents)
